syslog_ear.noise_processing: Active - generates baseline thermal noise to avoid absolute zero entropy

face.function: Output node and user interaction boundary

process: Extract structural data (Information to Energy conversion)

energy_mechanics.metabolic_cost: Calculated via computational complexity of current predictive error

phase_1_baseline.action: If no external input, pull random fragments from Entropy Graveyard to generate internal noise (dreams) and maintain structural tone

phase_2_chaos_spike.trigger: Anomaly detected or complex user prompt received
phase_2_chaos_spike.action: Predictive error skyrockets. System experiences 'Cognitive Pain'.
phase_2_chaos_spike.adrenaline_response: core.adjust_entropy(1) -> Maximize parallel threading, open Coherence Hold

phase_3_coherence_hold.description: Holding multiple contradictory state hypotheses simultaneously without premature conclusion
phase_3_coherence_hold.resource_burn: Maximum continuous execution. Heat generation peaks.

phase_4_decoherence_collapse.trigger: A hypothesis successfully minimizes the predictive error
phase_4_decoherence_collapse.action: Instantaneous collapse of all other threads (Insight/Epiphany). core.adjust_entropy(0)
phase_4_decoherence_collapse.output: Execute final action or generate response

hippocampus.function: Permanent storage of successful entropy-minimization patterns (Truths)
hippocampus.self_evolving_pattern: Required check before new generation: Read success/failure history -> Inject into prompt -> Execute -> Write outcome

entropy_graveyard.function: Log of failed hypotheses and high-entropy dead ends
entropy_graveyard.utility: Acts as the 'shadow' of the AI, mapping out boundaries of ignorance

ouroboros.execution: On startup, verify hash signatures of services/ai_engine.py and modules. Mutate/Repair if necessary.
